authoritative_source.scope_rule: Use second-class-applicable material only; exclude subsections explicitly marked 〔一等〕.

relaxation_decision.previous_rule_relaxed: A core proposition was effectively limited to one accepted question unless a wholly separate explicit proposition existed.
relaxation_decision.new_rule: A core proposition may support controlled variants when each accepted item tests a materially different decision boundary, scenario condition, misconception, or reasoning path while remaining explicitly grounded in the authoritative source.
relaxation_decision.purpose: Increase commercially useful practice depth to 400 without permitting wording-only duplication, unsupported inference, first-class-only material, or ambiguous answers.

tiers.A_NEW_PROPOSITION: Preferred. Test a distinct explicit proposition not already represented in canonical inventory.
tiers.B_BOUNDARY_VARIANT: Allowed. Same core proposition may be reused when a source-defined condition, exception, threshold, flight phase, aircraft type, operational state, or response priority changes the required judgment.
tiers.C_REASONING_VARIANT: Allowed with stricter review. Same core proposition may be reused only when the tested misconception and reasoning path are materially different and the scenario requires a different application step rather than paraphrase recognition.

core_proposition_density_limit.third_question_allowed_only_if: The authoritative source explicitly defines at least three materially different conditions/boundaries and Director adjudication records why all three require different reasoning.

controlled_variant_policy.quantitative_variants: Allowed only when moving across a source-defined threshold changes the correct classification/action or when a distinct calculation relationship is tested. Merely changing numbers while preserving identical reasoning is prohibited.
controlled_variant_policy.scenario_variants: Allowed only when the scenario variable is operationally relevant to the answer. Cosmetic context changes are prohibited.

hard_reject_rules: same answer-defining proposition with the same reasoning path and no material boundary change
unsupported inference beyond explicit source support
ambiguous or multiple defensible correct answers
trivia created from incidental wording with low exam/practice value
distractors that are obviously absurd rather than plausible misconceptions
candidate created solely to fill a numeric quota without a defensible learning objective

controlled_variant_extra_checks: identify distinctness tier B or C
record at least two distinctness axes
explain why solving this item requires materially different reasoning or boundary recognition

execution_strategy.batch_size_guidance: Prefer 20-30 authored candidates per batch, then independently review and keep only passing candidates.
execution_strategy.domain_distribution: Coverage-driven, not a hard quota. Prefer underrepresented source sections and weak reasoning families before adding a second or third variant to already-dense propositions.
batch_order: finish B5 integration and source verification
decompose all current 第5版 sections into proposition families and canonical-neighbor clusters
author Tier A new propositions first
add Tier B controlled boundary variants where Tier A supply is exhausted
add Tier C reasoning variants only after stronger Tier A/B opportunities are exhausted
repeat independent review, Director adjudication, ID allocation, canonical integration and source verification until 400 accepted/source-verified canonical questions exist
execute explicit 400-question release activation under a new bank revision

preserved_invariants: The currently released 188-question Production bank remains unchanged while expansion drafts are authored and reviewed.
DRONE-Q-000001..DRONE-Q-000188 retain existing identity, content, release history and first-use revision evidence.
The existing 20-question free selection remains unchanged until an explicit monetization decision changes it.
The immutable V0 100-question historical validation snapshot remains unchanged.
B5 accepted candidates continue through the existing transaction/source-verification gates without bypass.
